headline: On last trading day, Sensex jumped 900 points as IT and FMCG stocks led a sharp recovery

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 13 October.

why: IT stocks rallied significantly with major gains in heavyweights like TCS
Strong buying interest in the FMCG sector boosted overall market sentiment
All sectoral indices turned green as the market recovered from eight weeks of losses
Positive global cues and short-covering contributed to the Sensex jumping over 800 points
whatHappening: Government unveils New Steel Policy Vision 2047 targeting 600 MT output and raw material security
Adani's Kutch Copper plans to integrate 115-MW renewable energy to lower emissions
RBI's rupee defence measures are expected to drain banking system liquidity
Reports emerge of an 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine according to Donald Trump
summary: The Indian stock market ended its last session with a massive rally, as the Sensex surged nearly 900 points and the Nifty reclaimed the 22,500 level. The recovery was broad-based, led by a 3% jump in IT stocks and strong performance in the FMCG sector. While the market remains closed for the weekend, investors are monitoring new government steel policies and geopolitical developments in the Middle East and Ukraine.
